distribution.summary: Guizhou; Shaanxi; Sichuan; Yunnan; Hainan; Shanxi
distribution.narrative: Johnson et al. (2020) documented Guizhou, Shaanxi, Sichuan and Yunnan. The Hainan entry in Huang & Lu (2015) is not promoted to the current reviewed occurrence. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Hainan, Shanxi as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Pinus armandii and P. yunnanensis are retained as current reviewed hosts.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus lipingensis Tsai & Li, 1959.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus kesiyae
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 288.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus lipingensis
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Cryphalus kesiyae Browne, 1975 is newly synonymized with C. lipingensis; lectotype IOZ(E)213228 designated.
